message.content: {"evidence":"At index 635, N/E/U show a sustained ~2–4 mm elevation (N), ~2–3 mm eastward shift (E), and ~2–3 mm uplift (U) that persists until ~670, after which all components return toward the pre-635 trend line; the residual plot confirms a plateau-like offset followed by recovery, not just slope change. The later candidate at 670 is a sharp step but lacks a preceding platform and instead appears as part of ongoing displacement; R2 overlaps with R1 and shares endpoint, so only R1 is valid.","pair_ids":["R1"]}
